name: kalshi-crypto15m-bot
description: Kalshi 15-minute crypto trading bot: digital-option fair value, fail-closed risk gateway, OMS with reconciliation.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:bot

scripts.build:trainer: esbuild research/laptopTrain.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/laptopTrain.cjs --packages=external --log-level=error && esbuild research/pipeline.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/pipeline.cjs --packages=external --log-level=error && esbuild research/snnReplayWorker.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/snnReplayWorker.cjs --packages=external --log-level=error && esbuild research/sweepWorker.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/sweepWorker.cjs --packages=external --log-level=error && esbuild research/perpDatasetWorker.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/perpDatasetWorker.cjs --packages=external --log-level=error && esbuild research/gpWorker.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/gpWorker.cjs --packages=external --log-level=error && esbuild research/conditioningWorker.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/conditioningWorker.cjs --packages=external --log-level=error && esbuild research/taNetRowsWorker.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/taNetRowsWorker.cjs --packages=external --log-level=error
